checks.text: The page shows the heading "Color Contrast Checker" and the text "No pairs saved yet" in the Saved Pairs section.

Typing `#FFFFFF` in the field labelled "Foreground hex" and `#000000` in the field labelled "Background hex" shows "21.00" in the field labelled "Contrast ratio" and "AAA" in the field labelled "WCAG level".

Typing `#777777` in the field labelled "Foreground hex" and `#FFFFFF` in the field labelled "Background hex" shows "4.48" in the field labelled "Contrast ratio" and "AA" in the field labelled "WCAG level".

Typing `#AAAAAA` in the field labelled "Foreground hex" and `#FFFFFF` in the field labelled "Background hex" shows "2.32" in the field labelled "Contrast ratio" and "Fail" in the field labelled "WCAG level".

With Foreground `#FFFFFF` and Background `#000000`, clicking the button "Save pair" adds a list item containing "#FFFFFF on #000000" and "21.00" in the Saved Pairs section, and the text "No pairs saved yet" is gone.
After saving the pair `#FFFFFF` on `#000000`, clicking the button "Delete #FFFFFF on #000000" removes that list item and the text "No pairs saved yet" reappears.
Clicking the button "Copy result" with Foreground `#FFFFFF` and Background `#000000` shows the toast text "Copied: #FFFFFF on #000000 — 21.00 (AAA)".
Clicking the tab labelled "Palette" shows the heading "Generated Palette" and a list containing the text "#FFFFFF" as the first swatch label.
Reload keeps the saved pair: after saving `#FFFFFF` on `#000000` and reloading the page, the Saved Pairs section still contains the list item with "#FFFFFF on #000000" and "21.00".
